about: Funding programs relevant to First Nations and tribal farms, lands and water staff. Source: docs/nation-tools-research.md PART B section 3. Statuses were read on the url_checked date and change; verify on the program page before applying. verified=false means a key fact (status, scope or amount) rests on search results or a page that did not load. Edit via build_programs.py or this file.

programs.name: NASA Indigenous Peoples Initiative (Earth Action)
programs.eligible: Federally recognized tribes and Indigenous communities (as listed partners)
programs.funds: Training and co-developed workshops, not grants
programs.how_croplytics_helps: A NASA-data tool that could be used in trainings; not a funding route.

programs.name: NASA DEVELOP
programs.funds: 10-week feasibility projects at no cost to the partner
programs.status_note: term-based; develop.larc.nasa.gov did not load for the researcher
programs.how_croplytics_helps: A starting point for a DEVELOP project.

programs.name: NASA ARSET training
programs.how_croplytics_helps: Capacity building for staff who will read satellite data.

programs.name: NASA Western Water Applications Office (WWAO)
programs.funds: Co-developed tools (for example the Navajo drought severity tool)
programs.how_croplytics_helps: A precedent for a tribal water tool built on NASA data.

programs.name: USDA NRCS EQIP
programs.eligible: Producers, including tribes (tribes may get a higher payment rate and advance payment)
programs.funds: Conservation practices such as irrigation water management and cover crops
programs.typical_amount: Per-practice payment schedules; the underserved rate is at least 25% above base
programs.deadline: continuous sign-up; state ranking dates apply
programs.status_note: tribal payment-rate claim is from an NRCS Idaho page; the national page did not load for the researcher
programs.how_croplytics_helps: The report gives baseline crop water use, erosion and soil-cover figures per rotation; a cover-crop rotation maps to practice 340 and water-saving to 449.

reasons.default: Cover-crop and water-saving rotations compared here map to EQIP practices 340 and 449.

programs.name: USDA Indigenous Animals Harvesting and Meat Processing Grant
programs.typical_amount: Up to $50M total (ARPA); FY23 awards about $42M
programs.status_note: FY23 round closed 19 Jul 2023; page returned 403
programs.how_croplytics_helps: Weak fit: forage and range greenness for herd planning only.

programs.name: USDA NIFA Federally Recognized Tribes Extension Program (FRTEP)

programs.how_croplytics_helps: A tool extension agents can use with tribal farms.

programs.name: USDA Office of Tribal Relations
programs.how_croplytics_helps: A referral path.

programs.name: BIA Tribal Community Resilience Annual Awards
programs.eligible: Federally recognized tribes and tribal organizations
programs.status_note: BIA page: updates are pending on future funding cycles
programs.how_croplytics_helps: Drought and climate history plus rotation scenarios for an adaptation-planning narrative.

programs.name: BIA Water Management, Planning and Pre-Development Program
programs.eligible: Tribes, through the BIA Regional Office
programs.funds: Technical assistance and water surveys including quantification studies
programs.status_note: scope and FY27 call timing are from search snippets, not the program page text
programs.how_croplytics_helps: ET-based crop water demand and GRACE-DA trends as preliminary characterization of water concerns.

reasons.default: BIA Water Management funds water surveys and quantification studies; the water baseline and drought history here are preliminary inputs.
reasons.ca: {subbasin}: BIA Water Management funds quantification studies, which fits tribes whose reserved water rights are not yet quantified.

programs.name: CDFA Tribal Food Sovereignty Grant Program
programs.funds: Food systems (stewardship, cultivation, harvesting, production, distribution) and land return
